title: Tech Note: The Power of System Workers
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Still fully current: the System Worker class remains 4D's recommended way to shell out to the command line asynchronously, and LEP is still supported but positioned as the legacy/synchronous option.
related_updates: System Worker (introduced v19R4) has since been joined/extended by further worker- and class-based concurrency primitives in 4D; the core async-callback pattern shown here is still the documented approach.
Project mode / classes are required for this feature, reinforcing 4D's move away from binary-mode procedural code.
